decisions.current_rule: When ПО has the meaning 'after an event', the event noun is used in the prepositional case.
decisions.semantic_boundary: Do not generalize this to every ПО construction: other meanings of ПО can govern other case forms.
decisions.patch_policy: Existing unit already encodes the correct semantic boundary; keep one family and preserve grade-route scopes.

decisions.current_norm_note: The theoretical grammatical status of constructions with БОЛЕЕ + positive adjective is discussed in linguistics, but combining БОЛЕЕ with an already synthetic comparative is outside standard literary usage unless deliberately used as language play/quotation.
decisions.patch_policy: Keep the learner boundary as a norm check, not as a claim that linguistic theory has only one analysis of analytic comparison.
